messages:
elena (Product): Hey @channel — scheduling a compact all-hands next Wed 5/6 10:00am PT. Plan is 30m. Quick agenda: 1) Redwood Optimize beta launch callouts (10m) 2) Data retention & compliance policy update (7m) 3) SRE incident recap + mitigation checklist (7m) 4) Q&A + open floor (6m). Please drop 1-2 quick Qs below so we can prioritize. Slides/doc: https://go.redwood/ah-may6 (internal).

matt (Eng): can we get 5 mins for a short demo of the batching perf win? it's <2 slides and a 60s demo.

elena (Product): yes — we'll slot 5m inside the Optimize beta segment. thanks Matt. :thumbsup:

vera (Infra): can ops cover the incident mitigation checklist in the SRE recap? want to call out the new fallback policy and runbook links.

elena (Product): good call, Vera. we’ll have you cover the runbook + new fallback routing (3m) in the SRE section.

jordan (People Ops): heads up — I'll do a 60s reminder about the updated hybrid-work policy and new parental leave FAQ after the exec notes. is that ok?

elena (Product): perfect — put it in the Q&A block or quick 60s at the end. thanks.

sam (Marketing): will there be a short release note or TL;DR we can share externally for Optimize beta? if so, when do you need copy?

elena (Product): yes — we'll publish a TL;DR same day. aim to get final copy by Tue 5/5 EOD. Sam, can you own distribution?

sam (Marketing): on it. I’ll draft and post to the #marketing channel Mon afternoon.

elena (Product): reminder — drop any Qs here by Tue 5/5 2pm PT so we can collate and prep answers. we’ll prioritize customer-impact and security questions.

recording-bot: Recording will be posted to the all-hands page within 1 hour after the meeting.

elena (Product): Post-meeting — quick takeaways we'll share on the channel: 1) Optimize beta rollout plan + dev checklist 2) policy change: default data retention set to 90 days for hosted API (customer opt-in for longer) 3) incident follow-ups and the fallback routing timeline 4) links to slides + recording.

recording-bot: Recording uploaded: https://go.redwood/ah-may6-recording (internal)

elena (Product): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick inputs. If you can't attend, please add QA in-thread and Marta (PM) will take notes for follow-ups.

matt (Eng): noted, will post the demo gist after the meeting for anyone who missed it.

vera (Infra): leaving the runbook link here for prep: https://go.redwood/runbooks/fallback-routing (internal)

elena (Product): closing note — execs will take only high-impact Qs live. we’ll triage the rest asynchronously and follow up via PRs or docs. see you Wed! :spiral_calendar:
